target: Holybro X500 V2 + Pixhawk 6C PX4 reference quadcopter
intent: Documented assembly and engineering verification; no actual physical testing or flight authorization

sources.use: assembly order, power interface and PX4 setup
manufacturer kit options, supplied hardware and component identities
flight control and simulation, not component selection

reference_bom.part: Power module PM02 V3 or kit-specified compatible revision
BLHeli S 20 A ESC rated for 4S
1045 propellers with correct rotational handedness and retainers
X500 V2 power distribution board with battery and ESC connectors
SiK telemetry radio matched to regional frequency
4S 3000–5000 mAh 20C+ LiPo with confirmed XT60 interface
Compatible RC transmitter and receiver for planned flight mode
reference_bom.supply: purchase separately or document approved alternate

critical_variant_checks: Verify actual kit SKU and exact Pixhawk/power-module/GPS versions against package before wiring
Compare motor/ESC connectors: published kit descriptions vary between MR30 and XT30; do not assume mating compatibility
Confirm selected battery XT60 polarity, regulator rating, connector pinout, 4S suitability and charging/storage equipment
Verify props, motor rotational direction and PX4 actuator mapping for selected airframe revision
Confirm actual all-up mass, thrust-current curves, ESC thermal margins and battery capacity before calculating runtime
Confirm regional radio frequency and operator requirements before sourcing telemetry equipment

assembly_stages.task: Inventory kit, hardware variants, connector types, fasteners and exact manual revision
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Photos of labels, board revisions, complete parts inventory

assembly_stages.task: Build frame, landing gear, battery/payload rail and vibration-isolated flight controller mount per X500 V2 guide
Document PDB, ESC branch conductors and battery-to-power-module-to-POWER port separately; do not apply battery directly to regulated FC POWER port
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Connector pin map, polarity and rail-voltage design review

assembly_stages.task: Map the four ESC signal/ground leads, GPS, telemetry and RC to the exact Pixhawk 6C ports
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Port map and cable continuity review

assembly_stages.task: Select documented X500 V2 airframe in QGroundControl; verify actuator/output assignments
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Offline configuration manifest, parameter snapshot and reviewer signoff

assembly_stages.task: Plan separately authorized, propeller-removed bench verification for power, sensors, ESC channels and failsafes
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Independent powered-test procedure and physical supervisor approval

assembly_stages.task: Retain a hold until hardware measurements, local flight permissions and trained operator review are complete
assembly_stages.required_evidence: Physical validation, mechanical/electrical acceptance, aviation compliance
